yields.name: Generator Accelerator
yields.why: Since 1.0.32. Generator Accelerator (tested 1.20.1-1.4.10-3.1) replaces Beardifier.compute (m_207386_) with its own @Overwrite (mixin priority 900, applied before ours). Our @ModifyExpressionValue on the two iterator-field reads inside compute then finds no target and its require = 1 stops the server at the first world load ('Critical injection failure ... bons$rigids'). Our switch therefore stands down whenever that mixin is listed (names from Generator Accelerator's mixin config only; none of its code was read). Found by a minimal-pack rig with Bons and Furious 1.0.30, 2026-10-05.
